description: Logo officiel composé d'une carte d'Afrique avec réseau de points, compass icon, et wordmark

network_overlay.description: Points blancs reliés par des lignes représentant un réseau de connexions à travers le continent

compass_icon.description: Circular compass icon with green background and white letter 'G' in center

line_3.description: Word 'GROUPE' flanked by horizontal lines on both sides

reproduction_steps: 1. Draw Africa continent silhouette filled with blue #013C87
2. Overlay white network pattern (dots + connecting lines) on the map
3. Add white borders showing country boundaries within Africa
4. Place green circular compass icon (#1D7742) overlapping right edge of map
5. Center white letter 'G' in bold inside the green compass circle
6. To the right, stack text in 3 lines:
- Line 1: 'AFRIQUE' in green #1D7742, extra bold, large
- Line 2: 'BOUSSOLE' in blue #013C87, extra bold, large
- Line 3: Blue horizontal line + 'GROUPE' (blue, bold, smaller, wide spacing) + blue horizontal line
8. Ensure compass icon slightly overlaps map for cohesive look
critical_requirements: Africa map must show network connectivity pattern (dots + lines)
Compass icon MUST have letter 'G' centered in white
Text layout: AFRIQUE (green) above BOUSSOLE (blue) above GROUPE (blue with lines)
White network overlay on Africa is essential design element
forbidden_modifications: Do NOT change colors (blue, green, white only)
Do NOT remove network pattern from Africa
Do NOT change letter 'G' in compass
Do NOT rearrange word order (AFRIQUE first, BOUSSOLE second, GROUPE third)
Do NOT simplify or omit any element

brand_meaning.africa_map_with_network: Represents continental reach and interconnected business networks across Africa
brand_meaning.compass_with_g: Symbolizes guidance, navigation, and strategic direction (Boussole = Compass in French)

generation_prompt_template:
Create the Afrique Boussole Groupe logo with these EXACT specifications:

1. LEFT SECTION (35%):
   - Africa continent silhouette in solid blue #013C87
   - White network overlay: multiple dots connected by lines representing connectivity across the continent
   - White country borders visible within the map

2. CENTER SECTION (15%):
   - Green circular compass icon #1D7742
   - White bold letter 'G' centered inside the circle
   - Position: overlapping the right edge of the Africa map

3. RIGHT SECTION (50%):
   - Line 1: 'AFRIQUE' in green #1D7742 (extra bold, large, uppercase)
   - Line 2: 'BOUSSOLE' in blue #013C87 (extra bold, large, uppercase)
   - Line 3: [blue line] 'GROUPE' [blue line] in blue #013C87 (bold, smaller, wide letter spacing, uppercase)

4. LAYOUT:
   - All elements vertically centered
   - Horizontal composition: Map + Compass (slight overlap) + Text
   - Professional, balanced, clean design

CRITICAL: Use EXACT colors #013C87 and #1D7742. The network pattern on Africa and the 'G' in compass are mandatory elements.
validation_checklist: ✓ White network pattern (dots + lines) visible on map
✓ AFRIQUE in green above BOUSSOLE in blue
✓ GROUPE with flanking lines at bottom
✓ All three sections present and aligned
